purpose: .fft windows its samples (HANN), normalizes (NORM) and honors START=/STOP=.

oracle.derivation: Exact DFT of the windowed samples of 0.5 sin(2 pi 2k t) on [1 ms, 5 ms), 2/sum(w) scaling, cosine-referenced phase, normalized to the peak bin. HSPICE's FFT phase is cosine-referenced: Star-Hspice Manual Release 1998.2 ch. 25 (web.engr.oregonstate.edu/~moon/ece323/hspice98/files/chapter_25.pdf), Example 1 (p. 25-12), lists the 1 kHz carrier sin(wc (Time - td)), whose window starts on a whole cycle, at fft_phase -90.0050 deg. So a sine of phase 0 at a window start lands at -90 deg: its complex bin is -j times the sine-referenced value. The DC bin is real in either reference.
